tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ dgongs 'dus cho ga'i 'don 'grigs/ yan lag bcu pa/ oṃ na mo hūm̐/ phyogs bcu dus gsum= spyan gzigs bdag bskyed/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i steng*/ sngags drug phyag drug ma sngags dang*/ phyag rgya'i steng du rin chen mang*/ sh+lau ka re/ na mo/ sangs rgyas rkang gnyis= rta mchog rol pa 'don cha dang mthun par gsal 'dab/ hūm̐: phyogs bzhi= hūm̐ bzhi/ dngos grub sgrub la= srung 'khor mngon rtogs 'don tshig bdag nyid rgyu yi he ru ka thugs kar pam̐ las pad+ma ram̐ las nyi ma'i= hrī: sa bon hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje= le tshan gcig dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ la sna tshogs rdo rje shar dkar= zhes sogs/ hūm̐ hrī: ye shes rol pa dbang gi= mchod pa byin rlabs/ oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrī āḥ phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'di dag dang: sogs/ spro na/ bdud rtsi'i mchod sprin ma sor bzhag hūm̐ hrī: bhan+dha khor yug= sngags nyer cig bdun/ gsum/ hūm̐ hrī: snang srid 'khor 'das gnyis bsdus chos rnams kun: bdag bskyed dang mdun bskyed bsdus pa/ oṃ swa bha wa= mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur stong pa'i ngang las mdun gyi nam mkhar srung ba'i 'khor lo yangs shing rgya che ba'i dbus su/ e yaṃ ra sum keṃ raṃ bh+ruṃ: sogs kyis/ 286) dam tshig gi 'khor lo la thim par gyur cig bar/ pad+ma badz+ra rtsal gyi thugs ye shes chen po'i klong dkyil rang bzhin 'od lnga 'khrugs pa'i dbus su/ mdun bskyed shin tu bsdus pa/ mngon rtogs mal du/ eḥkun bzang mkha' klong ngang du dbyer med kyang: rten dang brten pa= gtso bo bskyed pa/ ḍā ki ni na ma swa hā: bar tshangs pa'i sgra dbyangs bzhin/ hrīḥ phyogs dang phyogs mtshams pad+ma 'dab brgyad steng: 'khor tshom bu brgyad bskyed/ ma ha kro dha ma ma sid+dhi hūm̐: bar me tog phreng mdzes ltar dang*/ hūm̐ hrī: dkyil 'khor bar khyams phyogs bzhi sgo bzhi nas:

ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: bar tshangs pa'i sgra dbyangs bzhin gsal gdab/ zhi khro/ pad+ma badz+ra rtsal gyi thugs ye shes chen po'i klong dkyil rang bzhin 'od lnga 'khrugs pa'i dbus su= nas/ khro bo khrag 'thung lnga bcu rtsa brgyad rnams gsal bar gyur: zhes dang*/ hūm̐ hrīḥ rang byung thugs rje ma 'gags rol pa'i sku: sogs spyan 'dren/ bzhugs gsol/ dbang bskur/ rgyas gdab/ phyag 'tshal/ mchod pa/ bstod pa cas las byang me tog zhing mdzes pa'i lta ba bzhin no/ dzapra la/ phreng ba byin brlabs/ sgrub chen lta bur/ lha tshogs gtso 'khor thams cad kyi thugs ka= sogs/ spyi dril chung bas bskor ba'am/ 287) rgyas pa dang*/ sngags 'khor gsal gdab/ dzapra bskul/ hūm̐ hrī: bskul lo bskul lo thugs dam gnad nas bskul: dzapra dmigs 'od zer spro bsdus bcas dzapra bzla/ hūm̐/ ye shes lha tshogs spyan 'dren gshegs/ sogs kyi mthar/ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ= sogs dang*/ ma hā pañca rak+ta ba ling ta khā hi/ zhes rol mo 'khrol/ bstod 'bum chen mos bstod pa'am/ brjod med shes rab mi g.yo chos kyi sku: sh+lau kas bstod/ thugs dam bskrul pa ni/ hūm̐ hrī: chos dbyings mu mtha' med pa'i pho brang nas: rtsa ba'i lha dgu dang*/ phyi 'khor bcas gtang*/ sgrub chen dus dzapra bcol ba/ mdun bskyed la dmigs te/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas rnams kyis/ rnal 'byor bdag cag thun mtshams bya yi bar/ grags stong rdo rje'i sngags sgra 'u ru ru// bzlas pa'i phrin las g.yol med mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol/ bshags skong la phyag 'tshal/ e ma ho: sangs rgyas kun dngos rdo rje lta bu'i sku: maṇ+ḍal/ yig brgya lan gsum gyi/ oṃ badz+ra bhu mi āḥhūm̐/ sa gzhi spos chus= 'dod yon/ hūm̐: snang srid snod bcu yid 'ong gzugs rnams kun: rgyal srid/ rgyal sras bcas rnams la: bkra shis/ sa rin chen gdugs mdzes gser/gyi yu ba can: kun bzang mchod sprin/

288) oṃ āḥhūm̐: phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rab 'byams rgya mtsho mtha' yas kyi: bshags pa la/ rang nyid tha mal du gnas pa'i spyi bor pad zla'i gdan la rdo rje rtse lnga pa= sogs/ yig brgya brgya la a sti dha na las/ mgon po bdag ni mi shes = tshig rkang drug 'phags pas mdzad pa'i/ sku gsung thugs rtsa ba= tshig lhug pa'i bshags pa/ blo bral du 'jog hoḥdagongs su gsol: gsan du gsol: gzigs su gsol:sa ston pa kun bzang yab yum sras dang 'khor: smon lam bcas/ bzang spyod/ byams smon/ kun bzang smon lam/ sogs ci 'grub/ tshogs zhus tshangs sgra'am spyi ltar/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta= zhal zas tshogs la nyes sgrib ma mchis kyang: byin rlabs/ skong ba/ hūm̐ hrī: stong gsum 'di 'am gzhan dag na: gzhan yang las gzhung*/ hūm̐ hrī: dngos su 'byor bshams yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i: hūm̐ hrī: kun gzhi klong yangs bhañja ru: rgyas par spro na/ bhan+dha khor yug yangs pa'i snod chen du: hūm̐ hrī: spyi gtsug bde chen 'khor lo'i bhan+dha ru: hrī: dung chen snod du dmar chen rba rlabs 'phyo: hūm̐ hrīḥ bhan+dha 'bar ba'i gtor gzhong du: hūm̐ hrīḥ dbyings rig ma bu'i byur 'dre rab bsgral 289) te: hūm̐ hrī: brdal khyab lpags pa'i kong bu ru: hūm̐ hrī: dur khrod gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor du: tshogs mchod/ tshogs bsgral ni/ e las gnam lcags 'bar ba'i khang sgrom nang: /nṛ dang tri las gnod bya dgra bgegs rnams// yan lag lcags sgrog gis bcings nyam thag pa// gnod byed mngon sum gsal ba nyid du gyur/ zhes bka' brgyad bde 'dus las byung ba dang*/ na mo/ rtsa brgyud bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa'i lha/ khyad par dregs pa'i ded dpon nyer gcig sogs// ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgya'i nus mthu yis// dgra bgegs thams cad khug cig gzugs la phob// nṛ tri ru tra aṅku sha ya phob/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ nga ni rig pa dpal chen he ru ka:

'khor 'das ro gcig lta bu'i phur bu yis: ma rig gnyis 'dzin bdud dang dgra bgegs rnams: snying rjes bsgral zhing gtub bo ki lā ya: ka dag mngon rdzogs sangs rgyas phyir mi ldog: oṃ dharmā dhārtu ki lā ya rū tra ya ma du na myog thuṃ rbad: tshangs sgra las/ hūm̐ hrī: gnod byed dgra bgegs ru tra gzugs phung la: sogs kyis mtshon chas bsgral/ hūm̐ hrī: bstab po bstab po lha tshogs zhal 290)du bstab: gsum pa bshags pa/ ho: bdag sogs ma rig lus dang ngag sems kyis: gnam phud/ hūm̐ hrī: bskang ngo gsol lo mchod do thugs dam bskang: drang ba/ hoḥrdo rje rgyal po yab yum dgongs su gsol: lhag ma/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañca a mṛ ta ha ho hrī: a ka ra ོsa/ hūm̐ḥhrī: dur khrod gsang chen rol pa'i dkyil 'khor du: de kho na nyid kyi bskang ba/ hūm̐ hrī: dngos po chos nyid yangs pa'i klong du bskang: he ru ka dpal grong khyer du: bsngo ba bya/ gshin don la bsngags pa gnas par dbang bskur ni/ ting nge 'dzin gyis dmigs bya bkug sa gzhi spos chus= maṇ+ḍal/ e ma mgon po= sh+lau ka gsum gyis gsol gdab/ slob dpon gyis/ e ma 'dir 'dus= rnams bum spyi bor/ sa hūm̐ hrī: sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin gtso= shel dang me long mgrin par/ hūm̐ hrī: zhi khro rang gsal dkyil 'khor gtso: gtor ma lag tu/ hūm̐: ba ling bcud ldan pho brang du: gtang rag maṇ+ḍal dang*/ sman rag gtor mchod 'bul zhing bstod pa bya/ rdo rje'i glu gar ni/ e ma ki ri kī ri/ masta ba li= ma skyes pas na mi 'gags zhing*/ nas/ klong gsal lhun grub ye rdzogs che/ 291) long khyab dang bstun te slob dpon gyis dam tshig rnam dbye bshad/ slob bu rnams mgrin gcig tu/ e ma rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob bka' drin chen po'i dpal: mchod bstod sa bcad ma stong tsam/ ye shes lha tshogs spyan 'dren gshegs/ rol mo bsgrag sa gzhi spos chus=

maṇ+ḍal/ bskul pa/ hūm̐ hrī: bla ma'i byin rlabs yi dam ting 'dzin lha: de yan gyis tshim pa drug ldan du 'gyur ba yin/ dngos grub blang ba rgyas pa/ sgrub chen dang*/ tshes bcu'i tshogs mchod spros bcas lta bu'i dus su/ las gzhung ltar bgegs bskrad/ gzhung gi byin 'bebs sam/ ti sgro'i gter byon/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: rje btsun chen po pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: sogs dang*/ le'u bdun ma'i bzhengs bskul mas dbab/ rtsa sngags kyi dzapra dbyangs mang du brjod/ dzapra bskul/ hūm̐ hrī: bskul lo bskul lo thugs dam gnad nas bskul: nas/ mdzad du gsol: lde'u btags pa'i sngags man ngag ltar bzla/ dngos grub rdzas rnams mchod pa/ gsang 'dus las byung ba/ 292) hūm̐:sa snang ba snod kyi 'jig rten gtor zhong du: ma hā bha liṃ ta khā hi: mkhon bcugs sbyong ba/ ye shes sku mchog= badz+ra sa mā dza sa brgyan pa'i yig brgya ci 'grub/ dngas grub blang ba/ hūm̐ hrī: bde chen yangs pa chen po'i pho brang nas: gtang rag mchod pa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: phyogs bcu zhing khams rab 'byams rgya mtsho mtha' yas kyi: sogs/ nongs bshags/ kye:dus gsum bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dgongs: dbyangs gsal yig brgya spyi 'gro'am/ pad+ma rigs kyi yig brgya bzla/ shis brjod ni/ hūm̐ hrī: rgyal ba'i sku ni ri rgyal lhun po ltar: mdun bskyed/ oṃ:khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad: rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub zhu: sangs rgyas yul du gshegs su gsol: sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang: khyed kyi brtse ba'i thugs rje yis: sems can rnams la dgongs nas kyang: slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol: 'gro rnams bde la 'god du gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra muḥ snod bcud skye 'gro lha dang bcas pa rnams: bsdu rim dang*/ bsngo ba/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'= brjod/ de las byung dang bdag gzhan dge ba'i rgyud:
sogs nas/ le tshan 'di'i 'jug cung zad zhig ma phyi par bskrun skabs chad dam snyam/
